title: Ronaldo’s UAE golden visa: How he keeps residency without owning property
description: Cristiano Ronaldo received the UAE Golden Visa in 2020, years before moving to Saudi Arabia’s Al-Nassr. Recognised for his achievements as an elite athlete, he qualified without needing to invest in Dubai property or establish a business. The programme’s long-term residency benefits explain how Ronaldo can continue living and playing in Saudi Arabia while maintaining ties with the neighbouring Emirates.

His hospitalization has stirred goodwill among political opponents, with leaders from both the BJP and INLD extending wishes for his swift recovery. This incident underscores the underlying camaraderie in Haryana politics, despite the competitive landscape, especially recognizing Hooda's legacy as a former chief minister.

title: Centre asks states to go into ‘mission mode’ to curb stubble burning
description: The Centre has instructed Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Punjab, Haryana, and Delhi-NCR to prevent stubble burning. Recent data showed a significant rise in farm fires especially in Madhya Pradesh and Rajasthan. States are required to implement action plans that urgently address the issue of crop residue burning. Effective monitoring strategies have been emphasized to ensure compliance and control.

The coaches have been customised to suit Bangladesh Railway's operational requirements while providing passengers with greater comfort.

title: Hazlewood’s six-wicket haul takes him past Lee, equals Ishant and Zaheer
description: In a remarkable display of skill, Josh Hazlewood surpassed the legendary Brett Lee's Test wicket record during the first Test against South Africa in Durban. Achieving his career-best with a six-wicket haul, Hazlewood ended up with eight wickets. This stellar performance was pivotal in Australia's commanding 214-run win, solidifying his status as one of the greatest fast bowlers in Australia's Test history.

This poignant story garnered around $400,000 from over 14,000 donors, who were unaware of the deception. Upon investigation, it was revealed that the couple misappropriated the contributions for lavish purchases while Bobbitt pursued legal recourse for his funds.

The rumour has sparked memes and speculation about Lamine Yamal winning, given their famous connection. US issues power grid emergency in 13 states: Reason and what it means for residents
description: In a decisive move to ensure grid stability during a peak demand period, US Secretary of Energy Chris Wright has empowered PJM Interconnection to manage local power generation units from October 13 to October 16. With temperatures hitting unseasonably high levels, demand has surged to approximately 111,500 megawatts on October 13. While residents are not required to take action, voluntary conservation measures may be recommended.

title: USCIS warns immigrants: Update home address within 10 days or risk missing documents
description: US Citizenship and Immigration Services mandates that immigrants notify them of any address changes within 10 days. Failure to report changes may lead to missed immigration documents and important notices. Changing the address with the USPS alone is insufficient, as it does not update USCIS records automatically. USCIS encourages using their online system for immediate processing of address changes.

title: US school bus driver removed from route after letting 10-year-old rescue kitten
description: Cynthia Morgan, a dedicated school bus driver in Maryland, was dismissed after she permitted a student to save a kitten. This decision has ignited discussions on student welfare and the appropriateness of the response. Parents and locals are rallying for her return as support grows. The school district insists on safety protocols, reflecting on Morgan's history with students, prompting an evaluation of transport safety rules and disciplinary actions.
